description: Source code for HashicorpSecretManager class which manages secrets in Hashicorp Vault, supporting authentication via AppRole, TLS certificate, or token. Provides methods for reading, writing, and deleting secrets asynchronously and synchronously, with caching and URL construction logic.

classes.name: HashicorpSecretManager
classes.description: A secret manager that interfaces with Hashicorp Vault, supporting various authentication methods and secret operations.
